title: Iwasawa theory of CM elliptic curves at potentially supersingular primes
summary: We develop a plus and minus Iwasawa theory for CM elliptic curves with potentially supersingular reduction at a prime $p\ge5$. We construct local points that satisfy suitable "jumping trace" relations using the Honda--Demchenko theory applied to height-two formal groups over local fields with small ramification degree. These local points allow us to study plus and minus Selmer groups of CM elliptic curves over the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_p$-extension, to construct the corresponding plus and minus $p$-adic $L$-functions, and to prove an Iwasawa main conjecture relating these objects.
